name: day
description: A live pane showing what the day looks like and what to tackle next, replanned from this session's own context after every turn.

horizonHours.title: Horizon (hours)
horizonHours.description: Hours ahead the plan covers by default (/today eod widens it to the end of the day)

refreshMinutes.title: Timer refresh (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: Replan on a timer this often while the session is open; 0 turns the timer off (turn ends still replan)

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for times in the plan; empty uses the machine's

dayEnds.title: Day ends (HH:MM)
dayEnds.description: When your working day ends, HH:MM, used for /today eod
